_about: The written time budget of every job of .github/workflows/ci.yml (A-TOOLS-08, 2026-11-14). limitMin is the job's timeout-minutes; budgetMin is what the job may take on a run (the rule: no job runs above about two thirds of its limit on three consecutive runs). measuredMin is the last measured range, in minutes, and the runs it came from. node tools/ci-budgets-check.mjs reads this file against ci.yml (every job has an entry, the limit is the entry's, the budget is two thirds of it or less) and, with --runs, against the last successful runs of GitHub.

godot-parity.measuredMin: 16 to 20 (the first third of the old godot-parity job, 43 to 63 minutes in all); 2026-11-14: twelve camera checks added, about 4 more (215 s in a scratch run), so expect 20 to 24

godot-sim.measuredMin: 14 to 18 (the second third of the old job)

godot-roll-render.measuredMin: 20 to 25 (the last third of the old job)

godot-audio-vfx.measuredMin: not measured on a runner yet; a scratch run of the same scripts on a busy Windows PC took about 11 min of checks (hash check 395 s)
